================================================================================
  AS-IS ARCHITECTURE DOCUMENTATION - FRD15EU_DB3 PROJECT
================================================================================

Date: March 25, 2026
Project: FRD15EU DB3 Embedded Firmware (DBALL3)
Build System: CMake (migrated from Keil uVision 4)
MCU Target: NXP LPC1766 (ARM Cortex-M3)
SDK Location: .cmake_migration/code/src/SDK/

This document describes the ACTUAL layered architecture of the migrated DB3
project as it exists in `.cmake_migration/code/src/SDK/`.

This architecture follows a three-layer OSI-like structure with clear separation
of concerns, adapted for DB3-specific features (DBALL3 remote start, D2DI
protocol, W2W functionality).

================================================================================
ARCHITECTURAL OVERVIEW
================================================================================

The codebase follows a three-layer architecture with clear separation of concerns:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  APP (Application Layer)                                                 │
│  High-level application logic, features, services, and vehicle control  │
│  ~34 libraries                                                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    ↕
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer)                                       │
│  Hardware abstraction, communication protocols, OS services             │
│  ~15 libraries                                                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    ↕
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  BSP (Board Support Package)                                            │
│  Low-level hardware drivers, peripherals, MCU-specific code             │
│  ~26 libraries                                                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

ADDITIONAL LAYERS:
- **ENTRY**: Application entry points (2 libraries: main functions, task init)
- **INC**: Configuration headers and build-time configuration files
- **UNUSED**: Archived mirror of all active layers (historical preservation)

    ├── APP/                      # Archived APP layer

    ├── ENTRY/                    # Archived ENTRY layer
    ├── HAL/                      # Archived HAL layer
    └── INC/                      # Archived INC layer


================================================================================
LAYER DEPENDENCY RELATIONSHIPS
================================================================================

The architecture enforces clear dependency rules:

    APP Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: HAL, BSP (through HAL)
      └─ Never depends on: ENTRY, INC (includes headers only)
      
    HAL Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: BSP
      └─ Never depends on: APP, ENTRY
      
    BSP Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: (nothing - lowest layer)
      └─ Never depends on: HAL, APP, ENTRY
      
    ENTRY Layer
      │
      ├─ Depends on: APP, HAL, BSP (orchestrates everything)
      └─ Never provides: reusable APIs (only entry points)
      
    INC Layer
      │
      ├─ Provides: Configuration headers (compile-time constants)
      ├─ Included by: All layers
      └─ Never contains: Executable code

################################################################################
###  APP LAYER - APPLICATION LOGIC (~34 LIBRARIES)
################################################################################


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
APP/features/ - PRODUCT FEATURES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

┌─ APP/features/dball3/ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  DBALL3-specific product features (remote start, wire-to-wire, display)   │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.about            - Product information and version management         │
│  lib.display          - Display management (LED patterns)                  │
│  lib.rsr              - Remote Start System (state machine, core logic)    │
│  lib.rsr_feature      - Remote Start Feature Management                    │
│  lib.rxt              - Remote Start Extension/Timer                       │
│  lib.w2w              - Wire-to-Wire Integration (module cascading)        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ APP/features/falcon/ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Falcon-specific features (telematics/tracking)                            │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  core/                - Minimal falcon core implementation                 │
│  core_framework.h     - Falcon framework header                            │
│  falcon.c             - Falcon main implementation                         │
│                                                                             │
│  NOTE: Falcon is minimally implemented in this project. Full falcon         │
│  feature set (CAN periodic, hazard control, OBD-CAN integration, etc.)     │
│  is not present in the current migration.                                  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
APP/framework/ - SYSTEM FRAMEWORK
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

┌─ APP/framework/ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Core system framework and status management                               │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.core                 - Core system initialization                     │
│  lib.status_system        - System-level status management                 │
│    (multi-file: status_system.c, status_system_get.c,                     │
│     status_system_set.c, status_system_init.c, status_system_vars.c)      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BSP/peripherals/ - PERIPHERAL DRIVERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

┌─ BSP/peripherals/analog/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Analog peripherals (ADC, DAC)                                             │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.dac                  - DAC driver                                     │
│  lib.hw.adc               - Hardware ADC driver (DBALL3-specific)          │
│  lib.hw.dac               - Hardware DAC driver (DBALL3-specific)          │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/can/ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CAN bus controller driver                                                 │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  com.ext.lib.can          - Low-level CAN driver (vendor library)          │
│  com.ext.lib.can.lut.sw   - CAN lookup table (software implementation)     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/gpio/ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  GPIO (General Purpose I/O) drivers                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.gpio_pl              - GPIO platform layer                            │
│  lib.gpio_wake            - GPIO wake-up source handling                   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/interrupts/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Interrupt handling (FIQ, IRQ, VIC)                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.fiq                  - Fast Interrupt (FIQ) handler                   │
│  lib.irq.usr_1700         - User IRQ handlers (LPC1700)                    │
│  lib.isr_1700             - Interrupt Service Routines (LPC1700)           │
│  lib.vic                  - Vectored Interrupt Controller                  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/serial/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Serial communication (UART, SIO, HOBP bus)                                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  com.ext.hobp_bus         - HOBP ISO K-Line bus driver (vendor library)    │
│  lib.sio                  - Serial I/O driver                              │
│  lib.sio_uart             - UART-based SIO implementation                  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/storage/ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Non-volatile storage (flash, NVFS, NVRAM)                                 │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  (Currently empty - storage implementations are in BSP/mcu/lpc1700/)       │
│  Note: lib.nvfs_1700 and lib.iap_1700 are in lpc1700/ folder              │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/timers/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Timer and real-time clock peripherals                                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.tmr                  - Timer driver                                   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ BSP/peripherals/watchdog/ ────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Watchdog timer driver                                                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.wdog                 - Watchdog driver                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


################################################################################
###  HAL LAYER - HARDWARE ABSTRACTION LAYER (~15 LIBRARIES)
################################################################################


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HAL/communication/ - COMMUNICATION PROTOCOLS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

┌─ HAL/communication/can/ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CAN protocol stack and vehicle integration                                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  com.ext.lib.can.v        - CAN vehicle protocol layer                     │
│  com.ext.lib.can.v.usr    - CAN user-level vehicle functions               │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ HAL/communication/d2d/ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Device-to-Device (D2D) communication protocol                             │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.d2d                  - D2D protocol implementation                    │
│  lib.d2d.code             - D2D code generators/scripts                    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ HAL/communication/d2di/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  D2DI (Device-to-Device Interface via UART for DBALL3)                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.d2di                 - D2DI protocol layer                            │
│  lib.d2di_uart            - D2DI UART driver                               │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: DBALL3-specific D2D implementation using UART instead of SIO.    │
│  Provides bidirectional communication with other modules via serial link.  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ HAL/communication/hobp/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Honda OBD Protocol (HOBP) - Type 6 immobilizer bypass                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  com.ext.hobp_type6       - HOBP Type 6 protocol layer                     │
│    Provides Honda vehicle immobilizer bypass functionality via ISO K-Line  │
│    communication. Implements challenge-response authentication, ISK        │
│    (Immobilizer Secret Key) storage, and programming mode support.         │
│    Uses com.ext.hobp_bus (BSP layer) for low-level bus communication.     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ HAL/communication/rf/ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  RF (Radio Frequency) communication                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.rf                   - RF transceiver driver                          │
│  lib.rftd                 - RF transceiver driver (variant 1)              │
│  lib.rftd2                - RF transceiver driver (variant 2)              │
│  lib.rf_loop              - RF receive loop/polling                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HAL/io/ - INPUT/OUTPUT ABSTRACTION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

┌─ HAL/io/ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Input/output device abstraction                                           │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.idb                  - Input debounce                                 │
│  lib.ied                  - Input edge detection                           │
│  lib.led_usr              - User LED control                               │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

│  (Scheduler libraries present but not individually inventoried)            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

│  lib.main_1700            - Main application entry (LPC1700)               │
│    - crt0.s               - C Runtime startup (assembly)                   │

│                                                                             │
│  lib.task_main            - DBALL3 task initialization                     │
│    - task_main.c          - Task scheduler main entry                      │

│  - inc.config.d2d/        - D2D configuration for DBALL3                   │
│  - inc.config.fw/         - Firmware configuration                         │

│    - config_rsr.h         - Remote Start System configuration              │
│    - config_rsr_feature.h - Remote Start features                          │
│    - config_rxt.h         - Remote Start Timer configuration               │

│  Falcon-specific configurations                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

│  UNUSED/APP/              - Archived application layer                     │
│  UNUSED/BSP/              - Archived board support package                 │

│  UNUSED/HAL/              - Archived hardware abstraction layer            │
│  UNUSED/INC/              - Archived include files                         │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: Preserves original folder structure and organization from the    │
│  legacy Keil project. This folder is NOT used in the CMake build and       │
│  serves only as historical reference.                                      │
│                                                                             │
│  Total: ~77 archived library components (mirrors of all active layers)     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
NAMING CONVENTIONS AND PATTERNS
================================================================================

The codebase follows consistent naming patterns:

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PREFIX CONVENTIONS                                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.*                - Internal library component                         │
│  com.lib.*            - Common/shared library                              │
│  com.ext.*            - External/vendor library                            │
│  com.inc.config.*     - Configuration header                               │
│  inc.config.*         - Include configuration                              │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SUFFIX CONVENTIONS                                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  *_1700               - LPC1700 MCU specific implementation                │
│  *_1766               - LPC1766 MCU specific implementation                │
│  *.usr                - User-level interface/wrapper                       │
│  *.v                  - Vendor-provided or vehicle-specific variant        │
│  *.f                  - Fast variant (optimized implementation)            │
│  *.machine            - Machine/assembly-level code                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  FILE ORGANIZATION PATTERNS                                                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Multi-file libraries often split by function:                             │
│    - *_init.c         - Initialization routines                            │
│    - *_get.c          - Getter functions                                   │
│    - *_set.c          - Setter functions                                   │
│    - *_vars.c         - Global variables                                   │
│    - *_private.h      - Private implementation header                      │
│                                                                             │
│  Example: lib.status_system/                                               │
│    - status_system.c, status_system.h                                      │
│    - status_system_init.c, status_system_get.c, status_system_set.c       │
│    - status_system_vars.c, status_system_private.h                         │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
DB3-SPECIFIC FEATURES
================================================================================

The DB3 (DBALL3) project includes unique features not present in other variants:

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. REMOTE START SYSTEM (RSR/RXT)                                          │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.rsr              - Complete remote start state machine and logic      │
│  lib.rxt              - Remote start timer extension and scheduling        │
│  lib.rsr_feature      - Feature flag management for remote start options   │
│                                                                             │
│  Integration: Works with vehicle detection, sensing, and function control  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. WIRE-TO-WIRE (W2W)                                                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.w2w              - Wire-to-wire integration for multiple modules      │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: Enables cascaded module installations with shared vehicle wire   │
│  connections between multiple DBALL3 units.                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. D2DI PROTOCOL (Device-to-Device over UART)                             │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.d2di             - D2DI protocol layer                                │
│  lib.d2di_uart        - D2DI UART driver                                   │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: DBALL3-specific D2D variant using UART instead of SIO, providing │
│  bidirectional communication between modules.                              │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  4. DISPLAY MANAGEMENT                                                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.display          - LED pattern-based user feedback system             │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: Programming mode visual indicators and status display through    │
│  on-board LEDs.                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  5. HARDWARE TACHOMETER INTERFACE                                          │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.tach             - Hardware tachometer reading (DB3-specific)         │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: Direct hardware interface for tachometer signal reading,         │
│  distinct from software tachometer processing (lib.tacho).                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  6. PRODUCT INFORMATION                                                    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  lib.about            - Product information and version management         │
│                                                                             │
│  Purpose: DBALL3 product identification, version reporting, and feature    │
│  capability advertisement.                                                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
CRITICAL OBSERVATIONS
================================================================================

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ARCHITECTURAL STRENGTHS                                                   │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ✓ Clear three-layer separation (APP/HAL/BSP)                             │
│  ✓ Consistent naming conventions across all libraries                     │
│  ✓ MCU abstraction with generic + specific implementations                │
│  ✓ Vendor code clearly marked (com.ext.* prefix)                          │
│  ✓ No deep nesting (max 4-5 levels), favoring clarity                     │
│  ✓ Multi-file libraries organized by function (init/get/set/vars)         │
│  ✓ Historical preservation in UNUSED/ folder                              │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  COMMUNICATION STACK EMPHASIS                                              │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  The communication layer is the most developed part of the system:         │
│                                                                             │
│  - CAN: Vehicle communication (3 libraries: driver + protocol + user)      │
│  - D2D: Device-to-device (2 libraries)                                     │
│  - D2DI: D2D via UART (2 libraries, DBALL3-specific)                       │
│  - RF: Wireless (4 libraries with variants)                                │
│  - HOBP: Honda immobilizer (2 libraries: bus + protocol)                   │
│                                                                             │
│  Total: 13 communication libraries across HAL and BSP layers               │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  LPC1700 SPECIALIZATION                                                    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Strong coupling to NXP LPC1700 MCU family:                                │
│                                                                             │
│  - 7 LPC1700-specific libraries in BSP/mcu/lpc1700/                        │
│  - 4 LPC1700-specific interrupt/ISR handlers                               │
│  - 2 LPC1700-specific entry points                                         │
│  - 1 LPC1766 scatter/linker file                                           │
│                                                                             │
│  Porting to another MCU would require replacing BSP/mcu/ and updating      │
│  ENTRY/lib.main_* and peripheral drivers.                                  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  FALCON MINIMALISM                                                         │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Unlike detailed documentation suggestions, Falcon features are minimally  │
│  implemented in this DB3 project:                                          │
│                                                                             │
│  APP/features/falcon/                                                      │
│    ├── core/              (minimal implementation)                         │
│    ├── core_framework.h                                                    │
│    └── falcon.c                                                            │
│                                                                             │
│  Full Falcon feature set (CAN periodic, hazard control, OBD-CAN, etc.) is  │
│  NOT present. This suggests Falcon telematics is not a primary feature in  │
│  the FRD15EU (Ford) DB3 variant.                                           │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  STORAGE DRIVER CONSOLIDATION                                              │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  BSP/peripherals/storage/ folder exists but is empty. Storage drivers are  │
│  actually consolidated in BSP/mcu/lpc1700/:                                │
│                                                                             │
│  - lib.nvfs_1700          (NVFS implementation for LPC1700)                │
│  - lib.iap_1700           (In-Application Programming - flash access)      │
│                                                                             │
│  This suggests storage is tightly coupled to the MCU's flash controller.   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
COMPONENT DISTRIBUTION SUMMARY
================================================================================

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  LAYER         │  LIBRARIES │  PRIMARY FOCUS                               │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  APP           │  ~34       │  Features, services, utilities, vehicle logic│
│  HAL           │  ~15       │  Communication, I/O, OS, power, security     │
│  BSP           │  ~26       │  MCU drivers, peripherals, bootloader        │
│  ENTRY         │    2       │  Startup and main entry points               │
│  INC           │  N/A       │  Headers and configuration files             │
│  UNUSED        │  ~77       │  Archived versions (inactive)                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  TOTAL ACTIVE  │  ~77       │  Application-ready libraries                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
CMAKE MIGRATION IMPLICATIONS
================================================================================

For CMake build system configuration, consider:

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. LAYER-BASED TARGETS                                                    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Create CMake library targets for each layer:                              │
│    - db3_bsp (BSP layer libraries)                                         │
│    - db3_hal (HAL layer libraries)                                         │
│    - db3_app (APP layer libraries)                                         │
│    - db3_entry (ENTRY layer)                                               │
│                                                                             │
│  Enforce dependency order: APP → HAL → BSP                                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. MCU-SPECIFIC ABSTRACTIONS                                              │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Create CMake options for MCU selection:                                   │
│    - MCU_FAMILY=LPC1700                                                    │
│    - MCU_VARIANT=LPC1766                                                   │
│                                                                             │
│  Use conditional compilation for MCU-specific code (*_1700, *_1766)        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. FEATURE FLAGS                                                          │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Create CMake options for optional features:                               │
│    - ENABLE_FALCON (default: OFF, minimal in current codebase)             │
│    - ENABLE_RSR (remote start system)                                      │
│    - ENABLE_W2W (wire-to-wire)                                             │
│    - ENABLE_D2DI (D2D over UART)                                           │
│    - ENABLE_HOBP (Honda immobilizer bypass)                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  4. VENDOR LIBRARY HANDLING                                                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  External/vendor libraries (com.ext.* prefix) may require:                 │
│    - Special compiler flags                                                │
│    - Binary-only distribution (no source)                                  │
│    - License compliance considerations                                     │
│                                                                             │
│  Identified vendor libraries:                                              │
│    - com.ext.lib.can (CAN controller driver)                               │
│    - com.ext.lib.can.v (CAN vehicle protocol)                              │
│    - com.ext.lib.obd_can (OBD-II diagnostics)                              │
│    - com.ext.hobp_bus (HOBP bus driver)                                    │
│    - com.ext.hobp_type6 (HOBP protocol)                                    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  5. INCLUDE PATH ORGANIZATION                                              │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Configure include paths for each layer:                                   │
│    - INC/common/ (common headers)                                          │
│    - INC/dball/ (DBALL3-specific configurations)                           │
│    - INC/falcon/ (Falcon configurations)                                   │
│    - SDK/APP/, SDK/HAL/, SDK/BSP/ (public interfaces)                      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
MIGRATION PRIORITIES FOR CMAKE BUILD
================================================================================

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PHASE 1: CORE INFRASTRUCTURE (CRITICAL PATH)                              │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. BSP/bootloader/          - Memory layout (scatter file → linker script)│
│  2. BSP/mcu/lpc1700/         - MCU initialization and system functions     │
│  3. BSP/peripherals/         - Essential peripheral drivers                │
│  4. ENTRY/                   - Startup code (crt0.s + main.c)              │
│  5. INC/                     - Configuration headers                       │
│                                                                             │
│  Goal: Achieve successful link and boot to main()                          │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PHASE 2: SYSTEM SERVICES (ENABLE BASIC OPERATION)                         │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  6. APP/framework/           - Core system initialization                  │
│  7. APP/services/timing/     - Timeout management (used everywhere)        │
│  8. APP/services/queues/     - Message passing infrastructure              │
│  9. HAL/os/scheduler/        - Task scheduling                             │
│  10. APP/services/trace/     - Debug output (for development)              │
│                                                                             │
│  Goal: Working OS with logging and inter-module communication              │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PHASE 3: COMMUNICATION & VEHICLE INTEGRATION                               │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  11. HAL/communication/can/  - CAN protocol stack                          │
│  12. HAL/communication/d2di/ - D2DI (if inter-module communication needed) │
│  13. APP/vehicle/diagnostics/- VIN reading and OBD diagnostics             │
│  14. APP/vehicle/security/   - DST and immobilizer integration             │
│                                                                             │
│  Goal: Communication with vehicle and other modules established            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PHASE 4: DBALL3 FEATURES                                                  │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  15. APP/features/dball3/    - Remote start, display, W2W                  │
│  16. APP/services/outputs/   - Output control (lock, unlock, etc.)         │
│  17. APP/services/sensors/   - Sensor reading                              │
│                                                                             │
│  Goal: Full DBALL3 product functionality                                   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  OPTIONAL: FALCON & SPECIALIZED FEATURES                                   │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  18. APP/features/falcon/    - Telematics (if required)                    │
│  19. HAL/communication/hobp/ - Honda immobilizer (if targeting Honda)      │
│  20. HAL/communication/rf/   - RF features (if wireless control needed)    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


================================================================================
NOTES ON VEHICLE-SPECIFIC CUSTOMIZATION
================================================================================

NOTE: The original documentation mentioned three vehicle-specific libraries
(com.lib.detect, com.lib.func, com.lib.sense) that should be present. These
are NOT visible in the current SDK structure exploration and may be:

1. Located outside the SDK/ folder (in VEHICLE_SPECIFIC/ root folder)
2. Part of libraries not yet migrated
3. Integrated into existing libraries under different names

For a COMPLETE migration, verify the location and migration status of:
- com.lib.detect/ (vehicle detection logic)
- com.lib.func/ (vehicle control functions - lock, unlock, etc.)
- com.lib.sense/ (vehicle sensor reading - doors, ignition, etc.)

These are CRITICAL for vehicle integration and must be included in the
CMake build system.

================================================================================

For questions or clarifications about the architecture, refer to:
- This document (as-is structure)
- docs/db3_architecture.txt (original proposed structure)
- Source code in src/SDK/ (ground truth)
- Build output files in build/db3_build/ (compilation artifacts)
